order: Draw up the delta re-review order and its executor report for the round-5e fixes. Pin the review to the two commits spanning the round-5d and round-5e checkpoints, enumerating each one individually rather than citing the range as a whole. Scope the audit to only what changed across that pin: this is a delta review, not a full re-audit of everything since the last clean verdict. Write both the order and the executor report as new files under roster/ so the review round leaves its own paper trail. State explicitly that a clean verdict on this pin is what clears the pending work orders out of revise status.
claims: We produced the order and executor report as new files under roster/, pinning the delta review to the two commits between the round-5d and round-5e checkpoints and enumerating each one individually as required. Together the two files add 118 lines with no deletions. The order records that a clean verdict on this pin is what clears the pending work orders out of revise status.
